description: React and Angular GIF pickers, a typed JavaScript client, Vue and Svelte examples, an importable n8n search workflow, and links to native Swift and Android SDKs.
rules: Published npm packages: @rowix/gifsnap-react 0.1.2, @rowix/gifsnap-js 0.1.0 and @rowix/gifsnap-angular 0.1.0. Run npm install with the package name. Angular installs its JavaScript dependency automatically.
Native Swift 0.1.2: install https://github.com/rowixgroup/gifsnap-swift.git via SwiftPM. Follow the native README for GifSnap/GifSnapUI products, imports and platform requirements.

Native Android 0.1.2: add Maven repository https://gifsnap.com/sdk/android, then com.rowix.gifsnap:gifsnap-compose:0.1.2 or gifsnap-client:0.1.2. Follow the native README for toolchain and platform requirements.
Render the full returned url for animation. preview_url can be static. Preserve IDs, complete URLs and source metadata; optional content_id is an opaque identity hint.
React uses GifPicker and a styles.css import. Angular uses standalone GifSnapPicker without a global CSS import. The JavaScript package is a client, not a Vue or Svelte component library.

Request pagination.next_page only when pagination.has_next is true and a next page exists. Preserve raw API counts; total can be an estimate. Empty pages stop continuation. Stop automatic fetching on duplicate-only batches.
HTTP base: https://gifsnap.com/api/v1. Exact GET routes: /gifs/search, /gifs/trending, /stickers/search and /stickers/trending. Keep the gifs/ or stickers/ segment.
SDK search uses query; HTTP search uses q. Both use page and limit. signal is a local Fetch option, never an HTTP query parameter.
Raw HTTP pagination defaults to page 1 and limit 25, requires positive base-10 integers, and caps valid limits at 50. JavaScript and React clients default to limit 24 and validate limits in 1-50.

Malformed or unsafe HTTP pagination returns 400; correct the request before retrying. Service failure can return 503. Handle errors and cancellation. No SLA, quota or media-license guarantee is provided.

createGifSnapClient() needs no arguments. baseUrl, fetch and timeoutMs are optional. Default baseUrl: https://gifsnap.com/api/v1. React has search/trending only; JavaScript/Angular also have searchStickers/trendingStickers.
